name: Spectral Scattering Model for Atmosphere
aliases: Nishita et al. Earth from Outer Space Method
Physical Model for Atmospheric Light Transport
Spectral Scattering Model for Atmosphere — Physical Model for Atmospheric Light Transport
Spectral Scattering with Water Bodies and Tone Mapping
definition: A physically-based model for simulating light transport in planetary atmospheres and large water bodies, accounting for direct illumination, indirect scattered light, interreflections between surface and volume, and seabed reflections. It uses fully spectral data precomputed into lookup tables for real-time GPU rendering.
summary: This physically-based model renders planetary atmospheres and water bodies using fully spectral computations within a single precomputation framework, distinguishing itself by supporting arbitrarily dense media and coupled water simulation.
